subject.title: fix(reef): discover trusted peers as conversations

question: Should the Plugin SDK baseline changes and the new durable unbound-conversation record semantics become supported compatibility contracts in this release?
rationale: The runtime design is coherent, but the PR changes a generated public API baseline and broadens persisted conversation records from session-bound rows to independently durable addresses; repository policy requires explicit owner intent for both compatibility-sensitive surfaces.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep the discovery and lazy-binding implementation, but prevent internal identity helpers or broadened record types from entering the Plugin SDK unless external plugins demonstrably need them.

options.title: Approve the new contract
options.body: Accept the Plugin SDK and durable-record changes as supported contracts after reviewing the exact baseline delta and adding focused external compatibility and upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause the broader refactor
options.body: Land a smaller Reef discovery repair only if the persistent-record and Plugin SDK changes cannot be safely reviewed for this release.

recommendation.title: Narrow the public surface
recommendation.body: Keep the discovery and lazy-binding implementation, but prevent internal identity helpers or broadened record types from entering the Plugin SDK unless external plugins demonstrably need them.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged conversation architecture and this Reef follow-up are both tied to their work, making them the strongest available owner for the compatibility decision.
